build_HFDataset: build a HFDataset builder with two builder configs and train/validation splits
create_HFDataset_info: create a HFDataset with DatasetInfo containing string id, int32 vals list, and answers sequence
test_HFDataset_splits: test the HFDataset builder generates TRAIN and VALIDATION splits with gen_kwargs
review_HFDataset_generate_examples: review the HFDataset _generate_examples method that yields id, vals, and answers examples
summarize_HFDataset_builder: summarize the HFDataset GeneratorBasedBuilder with VERSION, BUILDER_CONFIGS, and DEFAULT_CONFIG_NAME
